name: Dawn
detailed_description:
FEAR DAYLIGHT

Dawn is a dark fantasy post-apocalyptic survival horror game set in the ruins of a magical industrial revolution. Explore a surreal world overtaken by nature, where the horrors of the apocalypse emerge during the day and lie dormant by nightfall.

You are a corpse—resurrected 17 years after the world fell to ruin. The only thing keeping your body animate is a small pink flower embedded in your skull.

WELCOME TO THE GARDEN

Explore The Garden, a vast valley nestled on the coast of New Hampshire. Comprised of six distinct regions, The Garden was once home to a hardy few before industry consumed its rural, resource rich landscape. Every location is handcrafted, fully explorable, and has its own story.

DYNAMIC DAY/NIGHT CYCLE

Scavenge and explore at night. By day, hide from mutant plant abominations that roam the land.

Fear daylight.

CRAFTING & RESOURCE MANAGEMENT

Scavenge wrecks, car engines, and scrap to extract materials. Use them to craft or upgrade equipment, unlock new opportunities, and fight back against the horrors that hunt you.

CHALLENGING COMBAT

Fight for your undead life with a deep, skill-based combat system. Wield a variety of improvised tools, weapons, and gadgets to survive brutal encounters.

SANITY & SKULL FLOWER

Maintain your sanity in a decaying world and tend to the flower growing from your skull. It’s the only thing keeping your corpse alive.

MELODIES

Wield the strange mutant power of Melodies—unique magical skills that grant you an edge in the fight for survival.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 11th Gen Intel Core i7-11800H
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Sound Card: NVIDIA High Definition Audio

content_descriptors.notes: Minimal blood effects, crude language, alcohol consumption, dark themes,  and violence.
